decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system remains an open option because its specialized marine demand is still uncertain but strategically relevant, and the firm can keep it at moderate cost while monitoring results.
As a general interior lighting luminaire with a dedicated page and continued presence, its value is sufficiently proven and keeping costs are low, so the option is retained.
This microprismatic pendant luminaire is positioned as a flagship and aligns with the firm's strategic shift toward intelligent, energy-efficient lighting, so it is kept as a central growth option.

The marine searchlight remains on the market as an open option, but because its related HMI variant has already been dropped, the firm will continue to evaluate its niche demand and may abandon it if no value materializes.
